prompt: Create a realistic vertical mirror selfie portrait of a stylish young South Asian man in his late 20s to early 30s with medium olive skin, thick dark brown swept-back hair, and a neatly trimmed full beard standing indoors in front of an ornate designer mirror. He wears a black kurta with a short button placket and black pajama trousers, with the sleeves casually rolled to the forearms. Show exactly 4 prominent accessories: black sunglasses resting on top of his head, a silver luxury wristwatch on his left wrist, a dark ring on his right hand, and a small black perfume bottle in his right hand. He is spraying perfume toward his neck and collarbone, with a visible mist cloud in front of his chest; his left hand lightly adjusts the collar. His expression is calm, confident, and slightly serious, gazing at his reflection rather than the camera. Frame him through a large cream-colored baroque mirror with elaborate carved scrollwork along the top and sides, including the lower mirror edge visible. The background is a softly blurred modern dressing area with a bright window on the right, gray curtains, and faint shelves of grooming products on the left. Use natural daylight, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, soft highlights, and a polished fashion-lifestyle photography look. Vertical 9:16 composition, waist-up framing, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张写实的竖版镜面自拍肖像，画面主体为一位 20 多岁到 30 多岁、肤色呈中等橄榄色、留着浓密深棕色后梳发型和修剪整齐络腮胡的时尚南亚男士，他正站在室内一面华丽的设计师镜子前。他身穿一件 带有短门襟的黑色库尔塔长衫和黑色睡裤，袖子随意卷至前臂。画面需清晰展示 4 件醒目的配饰：头顶架着一副黑色太阳镜，左手腕佩戴一块奢华银色腕表，右手戴一枚深色戒指，右手握着一瓶小巧的黑色香水。他正将香水喷向颈部和锁骨，胸前可见明显的喷雾云；左手正轻轻整理衣领。他表情冷静、自信且略显严肃，凝视着镜中的倒影而非镜头。通过一面巨大的奶油色巴洛克风格镜子进行构图，镜子顶部和侧面带有精致的雕刻卷轴花纹，镜子下边缘清晰可见。背景是虚化处理的现代更衣区，右侧有明亮的窗户和灰色窗帘，左侧隐约可见放置理容产品的架子。采用自然日光，浅景深，写实的皮肤纹理，柔和的高光，呈现出精致的时尚生活摄影质感。竖版 9:16 构图，半身取景，无文字，无水印。
